description: The SSE stream routes the generated kernel application registers, as (method, path template). live-view and spectate are served for @ExerisDomain(realTimeApi = true); action-stream for each @Action(streaming = true), which then has no respond-once route. {base} is DomainMetadata.effectivePath(); {action} is kebab(@Action name). routes lists the routes a generated TypeScript stream client opens; withoutClient lists the routes the application serves and no generated client opens yet. StreamRouteParityE2ETest (exeris-e2e-tests) proves the generated application registers exactly routes plus withoutClient through streamRoute(...); stream-route-parity.spec.ts (exeris-codegen-ts) proves the generated TypeScript stream clients open exactly routes. A route moves from withoutClient to routes in the change that emits its client. Change it only together with the application generator.
